name: Strip Me Down! Office Worker
source:
It's time for Kyle's annual review and what better way to decide his new raise than by playing a game of NSFW strip Rock Paper Scissors in this short and sexy gay mini game.

If he wins, Kyle will get another grand on his salary... But if you win, he'll take off a piece of his clothing.

Keep on playing till he's got nothing left to show.

Play through the short story and progress by winning games of Rock Paper Scissors against Kyle, and maybe you'll be lucky enough to earn your happy ending...

Can you beat him?
translation:
是时候凯尔进行年度回顾了，还有什么比在这个简短而性感的同性恋迷你游戏中玩NSFW脱衣剪刀石头布游戏更好的方式来决定他的新加薪呢。

如果他赢了，凯尔的薪水将得到另一笔奖金……但如果你赢了，他会脱掉一件衣服。

继续玩，直到他没有什么可展示的为止。

通关短篇故事并通过赢得凯尔的剪刀石头布游戏来取得进展，也许你会很幸运地获得幸福的结局……

你能打败他吗？
